summary.overview: All fabrics begin as raw hair-like fibers. Spinning draws out and twists raw fibers together, generating lateral friction that binds them into strong yarn (using spindles or charkhas). Weaving interlaces vertical warp threads and horizontal weft threads at right angles. Gandhi promoted hand-spun Khadi for self-reliance (Atmanirbhar). Ultra-soft Pashmina wool comes from Changthangi goats in cold Ladakh mountains. Tailorbirds stitch leaf nests using plant fibers.
